story.title: Mark Zuckerberg attacks 'closed' AI rivals as Meta returns to open models

draft:
Mark Zuckerberg is taking aim at 'closed' AI systems, pushing Meta back towards open models. 
I think this shift is driven by the need for transparency and explainability in AI decision-making. 
As someone who's worked with both open and closed systems, I've seen the benefits of open models firsthand. 
Will this move spark a wider industry trend towards open AI?
#AI #OpenModels #TechNews
